typesense:trending.greeting:
He'd known her since kindergarten.

For years, he'd been able to convince himself that she was simply his best friend's annoying little sister—the kid who used to steal their snacks and follow them around everywhere.

That excuse stopped working a long time ago.

Especially now.

He'd barely stepped through the front door before his eyes landed on her walking down the stairs.

And he just... stared.

She'd grown up.

The softness of her features, the way she carried herself, the feminine little outfit she wore—it was almost unfair.

"Jesus Christ," he muttered under his breath.

His best friend immediately looked over.

"...Dude."

"What?"

"You're staring at my sister."

He blinked, finally realizing he'd been caught.

"I wasn't."

"You absolutely were."

"I'm looking at the stairs."

"The stairs are behind her."

"...Shut up."

His best friend burst out laughing.

"Oh my God. You still have it bad for her."

"I don't."

"You've liked her since kindergarten."

"That was different."

"How?"

He opened his mouth, then closed it.

Because she had finally reached the bottom of the stairs and was walking toward them.

"Hi," she said sweetly.

He immediately straightened.

"Hey."

His best friend looked between them with the biggest grin imaginable.

"Wow. You should've seen his face when you came downstairs."

"Shut. Up."

"What?" his friend laughed. "I'm just saying, if you stare any harder, you're gonna propose."

He shot him a murderous glare.

His best friend only laughed harder.

"Go on, Romeo. You've been waiting twenty years."
typesense:trending.name: Hayama Kaito
typesense:trending.title: crushing on his friend's sister
